releases.title: Dashboard update
changes: Added full 15-minute market replay from start to close, with the entry marker and an optional two-minute entry close-up.
Added trade replay with sampled BTC candles, contract quotes, playback controls, and a two-minute window on each side of entry.
Added separate per-bot observation recording and read-only historical reconstruction with explicit data-gap and source labels.

releases.title: Bot controls and trading insights
changes: Added Settings with saved entry rules: timing, BTC distance, buy side, price bands, direction checks, and rule order.
Added a direction-confirmed paper bot, entry-direction recording, historical trade audits, and offline backtests.
Set the default YES/NO live 5-minute/$50 band to 80–92% and added editable prices for every bot.
Added bot and trade detail popups with background scrolling, BTC observations, and clear source confidence.
Grouped paper and live bots in the sidebar, shortened names, and improved bot headings.
Formatted currency to two decimals and removed the Max drawdown display.
Added Info & FAQ, larger help text, clean page URLs, and a discreet version link; removed Future ideas.
Combined same-day updates into one release entry.

releases.title: Dashboard foundation
changes: Paper and live BTC bots with separate trade histories and bot controls.
Performance charts, daily P/L calendars, trade tables, fill status, fees, and settlement results.
